### 🔵 Needs a closer look

Legacy mode unnecessarily performs target lookups on every Redis command.

<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

### Suppressed comments (1)

**Previously missed (1)** — in code that hasn't changed since the last review.

**instrumentation/jedis/jedis-3.0/javaagent/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/jedis/v3_0/JedisRequest.java:36**
* [Performance] This target lookup now runs for every Redis command, including the default legacy-semconv mode, even though both server getters ignore `getServerTarget()` in that mode. That adds a `Context.current()` plus `VirtualField` lookup on the command hot path without affecting legacy telemetry; gate the lookup on stable database semconv.
